adversarialPromotionControls.whyNot: These controls test that a PROMOTION RULE does not fire on weak evidence. No promotion rule was added, and the existing intake predicate reads only DiscoveryRole - so a control asserting that a topical-only or threshold-only candidate 'remains non-promoted' at intake would be asserting something the predicate does not decide, and would pass for the wrong reason. The real A-J boundary is enforced after compilation by normalize.ts sufficiency, the IR type-checker and Phase-3C verification, which have their own existing suites. Building decorative controls here would be the kind of evidence this backlog exists to remove.
